title: SMB Share Access Review
summary: Sample write-up layout for documenting anonymous share access in a local lab.
body:
SAMPLE WRITE-UP — replace with your reviewed evidence before publishing a real report.

Objective
Evaluate whether an intentionally vulnerable local lab permits anonymous SMB access.

Method
Enumerate exposed SMB services, then verify access using smbclient with anonymous authentication in the authorized environment.

Finding
Anonymous directory listing demonstrates read access. A scanner result suggesting write access needs a separate safe manual test before it can be claimed as verified.

Remediation
Disable guest access, restrict share permissions, and limit SMB exposure to trusted networks.

Reflection
Record the commands, sanitized evidence, limitations, and lessons from the exercise.
